notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Game Update Announcement

We've made some exciting updates to enhance your gaming experience!

Tutorial Enhancements - We've improved our tutorials to make starting your adventure even easier.
Background Music Update - Enjoy new tunes that will bring your gameplay to life!
Camera Zoom Function - We've added a camera zoom feature to give you better control over your view.
Enjoy these new features and thank you for playing!
